en.text: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

footnotes.text: 117:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 万国啊，你们都当赞美耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 萬國啊，你們都當讚美耶和華！

en.text: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 因为他向我们大施慈爱；

zhTraditional.text: 因為他向我們大施慈愛；
